text.description_html:
ABH 3/4 Inch Offset Electric Intermediate Pivot Hinge E-019

Provides electrical power transfer from the frame to the door. For use with 3/4" offset pivot sets. Helps maintain door alignment.

Specifications: for ABH-019-3/4

  • Hinge Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Height: 5"
  • Width: 5-3/4"
  • (8) 30 AWG Wires
  • Thickness: 5/16"
  • UL Listed for use on 3-hour fire rated doors
  • Heavy duty stainless steel needle bearings
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Handed

Package with matching finish machine screws. For metal and doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
